issue: उत्राणी — not found in Monier-Williams, Apte or Platts as a name of the Goddess; both witnesses print it. Perhaps a form of Rudrāṇī or Indrāṇī, or a local name.
alternatives: A slip for रुद्राणी / इन्द्राणी; उत्तराणी.

issue: पाटन मुम्बा दन्त कुमारी — read as the shrine goddesses Pāṭan Devī and Mumbā Devī and one name Danta Kumārī; दन्त and कुमारी may be two (Danteśvarī and Kumārī, Kanyākumārī).
our reading: Pāṭan, Mumbā, Danta Kumārī and Bhadrakālī.
alternatives: Pāṭan, Mumbā, Danta (Danteśvarī), Kumārī and Bhadrakālī.
